sources.title: Waveshare 2.8-inch ESP32-S3 board / store
sources.note: Indexed manufacturer price $19.99-$25.99; select non-touch version and reconfirm checkout.

sources.title: Waveshare hardware documentation
sources.note: USB-C, SD, PCM5101 DAC and amplifier; supplied 8-ohm 2 W 2030 speaker. Active area and module drawing checked.

sources.title: Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 2.4-inch
sources.note: Indexed manufacturer listing from $19.90. Page has conflicting resolution text: headline 320x240, specification table 800x480. Confirm exact SKU and speaker load.

sources.title: EastRising ER-TFT024IPS-3 / BuyDisplay
sources.note: Indexed manufacturer price $6.37 one / $5.71 at 100, base option. 42.72 x 59.26 x 2.3 mm; active 36.72 x 48.96 mm. Touch and connector options can add cost.

sources.title: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8 / DigiKey
sources.note: Reference USD price $6.32 one / $4.7741 at 100. Live page reports zero stock; price is not a procurement commitment.

sources.title: MAX98357AETE+T / DigiKey
sources.note: USD $4.08 one / $2.56090 at 100; stock shown on page. Bare IC for custom PCB, not a complete module.

sources.title: PUI AS04008MR-2-LWC80 / DigiKey
sources.note: USD $4.94 one; $3.00725 at 80+ tier used for 100-unit estimate. 183 in stock at indexed check; recheck. 40 mm diameter x 5 mm, 8 ohm 2 W.

sources.title: PUI AS04008CO-R slim speaker / DigiKey
sources.note: USD $6.08 one / $3.626 at 100; live stock shown. 40 x 20 x 5.8 mm; 8 ohm 2 W. Compact alternate for Cube, Horizon, Timber and Plinth.

sources.title: Adafruit 128MB microSD, product 5250
sources.note: USD $3.95 one / $3.16 at 100; live in stock. Use read-only song data after factory programming.

sources.title: Sharp LS027B7DH01A / DigiKey
sources.note: USD $29.29 one / $23.606 at 10 / $19.06238 at 400. True reflective monochrome; active area 58.8 x 35.28 mm, 400x240. Not the panel shown in the six budget concepts.

sources.title: Epishine indoor energy output
sources.note: Manufacturer gives up to 22 microwatts per square centimetre at 500 lux. Used as an optimistic indoor harvesting reference, not the performance of the Voltaic outdoor panel.

sources.title: Voltaic P124 1.2 W / 6 V ETFE panel
sources.note: USD $14 one / $11.30 at 100. 113 x 66 x 2.6 mm, 31.6 g. Nominal marketed 1.2 W; listed peak test power 1.35 W, not indoor output.

sources.title: Adafruit BQ24074 solar / USB charger, product 4755
sources.note: USD $14.95 one / $11.96 at 100. Power-path/load sharing. Use its regulated LOAD output and a suitable 5 V boost stage; do not connect solar raw output to USB.

sources.title: Adafruit protected 2200mAh cell, product 1781
sources.note: USD $9.95 one / $7.96 at 100. 69 mm x 18 mm diameter, 46 g, 3.7 V nominal. Connector polarity and charge current must match the chosen circuit.

sources.title: MEAN WELL GST18A05-P1J / Bravo Electro
sources.note: USD $14.10 one. Desktop 5 V / 3 A supply with AC cord, not a wall plug brick. AC lead and barrel-to-USB-C power adapter are extra; design includes neither.

sources.title: Adafruit 40mm / 4-ohm speaker, product 3968
sources.note: USD $4.95 one / $3.96 at 100. 40 mm x 20 mm. Live Adafruit and DigiKey both out of stock. Alternative for a separately verified 4-ohm amp, not a drop-in for the Waveshare supplied speaker.

sources.title: Waveshare 2.7-inch e-paper
sources.note: Manufacturer selection table gives 6 s full refresh for this model. This inexpensive e-paper route does not support the intended continuous moving video.

sources.title: PUI round-speaker engineering data
sources.note: Manufacturer confirms 40 x 40 x 5 mm, 8 ohm, 2 W, 10.7 g and 400 Hz resonance. No claim of hi-fi bass or tested system quality.
